author: Asher Deinken
title: Man charged for SF motel knifepoint robbery - NewsBreak
text:
By Asher Deinken No media credit provided. ,
8 hours ago
SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (KELO) – Sioux Falls police responded to a weapons violation call at 6:42 a.m. on June 24, near West Russell Street and North Westport Avenue.
The caller said that someone was pounding on his door. When he opened it, a man with a knife was standing there, and he began yelling and screaming at him, police said in an email to KELOLAND News.
A woman who was with the man ran past the caller and into the room. The man then stabbed the door with his knife, and the caller ran out of the room to the office of the motel to call 911.
2 people airlifted after a head-on crash near White The caller said he saw the woman leave his room carrying his dog, so he ran after her and was able to get the dog back. A witness on the scene confirmed the events after police arrived.
The man was located by officers investigating the scene and identified as Alex Onestar, police said in the email to KELOLAND News. He was taken to jail for first-degree robbery. The woman has not been identified.
